channel.description: Latest articles from Now Magazine – Bias and Credibility (nowtoronto.com)

item.title: Toronto to conduct controlled fires in High Park and Lambton Park - NOW Toronto
item.description: Toronto will conduct controlled burns in High Park and Lambton Park to protect rare Black Oak woodlands and restore local ecosystems.

item.title: ‘We need to be focused on our country,’ This Toronto councillor wants to ban foreign flags at City Hall - NOW Toronto
item.description: Two Toronto city councillors have introduced a motion aimed at banning foreign flags from flying in front of Toronto City Hall.

item.title: Parkdale teachers voice support for tenant rent strike ahead of rally this week - NOW Toronto
item.description: Parkdale teachers join tenants on rent strike, warning that a proposed above-guideline rent increase could displace families and students.

item.title: ‘What’s better than a cuddly large dog?’ Toronto Animal Services waives adoption fees for bigger dogs - NOW Toronto
item.description: From March 23 to April 23, Toronto Animal Services is waiving all adoption fees for large dogs and puppies of large-dogs breeds.

item.title: Sold-out Punk Talks panel rounds up OGs from late 70s Toronto punk scene - NOW Toronto
item.description: The Punk Talks panel was held at Peach Berserk in Parkdale, featuring three OGs reminiscing about Toronto’s late-70s punk scene.

item.title: ‘You have to date yourself first,’ Torontonians are sharing how they solo date, and an expert shares tips - NOW Toronto
item.description: More Torontonians are embracing solo dating, and an expert emphasizes that the most important relationship starts with yourself.

item.title: What we know about the two Canadian pilots identified in the New York crash - NOW Toronto
item.description: Two Canadian pilots have been identified after a deadly New York runway collision involving an Air Canada Express flight.

item.title: ‘Ain’t My Fault’ you’re obsessed, here’s a Zara Larsson playlist ahead of her Toronto show tonight - NOW Toronto
item.description: Toronto, pull out your best Y2K outfit that’ll make Zara Larsson “Never Forget You” at HISTORY on Tuesday.

item.title: Hours before showtime, most seats remain open for FKA twigs in Toronto - NOW Toronto
item.description: A large number of tickets for FKA twigs’ Toronto show remain unsold ahead of her performance Tuesday night at Coca-Cola Coliseum.

item.title: Canadian government extends student funding increases - NOW Toronto
item.description: With reductions to provincial grants, changes to loans, and tuition increases on the way, student funding in Ontario is precarious right now...
